strokes.text: Manages one Move Source filter from the Move plugin, which animates a placement to a target position, scale and rotation.
The filter sits on a scene or group and names the placement to move by its source name.
The Move plugin must be installed in OBS; declare it with @resources/plugin or install it by hand.
The provider configures the filter and never starts it: triggering the animation is left to a hotkey, a controller or the OBS interface.
Only manual triggering is supported, so `start_trigger` and `stop_trigger` stay 0 and `enabled_match_moving` stays false.
Import with a JSON object that names the collection, parent UUID, parent name and filter name:

glazes.name: Name of the filter as shown in OBS. Changing it replaces the resource.
glazes.position_x: Target horizontal position in pixels. Defaults to 0.
glazes.position_y: Target vertical position in pixels. Defaults to 0.
glazes.rotation: Target rotation in degrees. Defaults to 0.
glazes.scale_x: Target horizontal scale factor. Defaults to 1.
glazes.scale_y: Target vertical scale factor. Defaults to 1.
